policy.privacy: Operator accounts are never echoed. Copies run by the same operator share an opaque operator number. Endpoints, mirror URLs, and free-form probe reasons in the evidence are never echoed; node names and operator-declared regions are already public on the mirrors payload.

copyClasses.meaning: Integrity gate rejected the copy, the node is abuse-blocked, or its clone probe from the last day failed.
Online, current, integrity ok, and either a signed endpoint receipt within the freshness objective or a clone probe from the last day that passed.
Only a catalog record exists; nothing ever observed the copy.
Observed before, but now offline, behind, or with no evidence within the freshness objective.

Online and seen within the freshness objective, but not yet backed by a signed receipt or passing probe, or a filtered, metadata-only, or deferred-object replica (replicaScope other than full) that never counts as verified.

proofStates.label: Quorum proven
proofStates.headline: Independent operators hold the same verified copy

proofStates.label: Below quorum
proofStates.headline: Verified, but not by enough independent operators

proofStates.label: Not proven
proofStates.headline: No copy has fresh signed evidence

risks.when: distinct operators holding the counted verified state < quorumTarget
passing clone probes on verified copies returned more than one refs digest
verified copies >= 2 and all share one operator
the working-copy source is known and offline
verified copies > 0 and none passed a clone probe in probeFreshMs
verified copies with the reference branch count < min(quorumTarget, verified copies)
verified copies with the reference artifact count < min(quorumTarget, verified copies)
verified copies >= 2, every one declared a region, and all declared the same one
